# Compiled

Everything in one file.

# Bundle notes

The first part of this fixture carries enough consecutive words for the eight
word gram detector to have something real to measure, and it shares no phrasing
at all with the second part, so every overlap the harness reports between the
two of them would be a genuine finding rather than an artefact of the fixture
being written twice by a tired author on a Friday afternoon in July.

# Rule notes

The second part of this fixture also carries enough consecutive words for the
detector to work with, and it exists so that a near identical sibling can sit
beside it and produce one honest duplication finding that nothing in the bundle
logic is allowed to suppress, because suppressing it would trade one false
positive class for a blind spot, which is a strictly worse trade to make.
